title: Halloween pumpkin ad for Sukoon Spa
text: A seasonal med spa ad: a wrinkled pumpkin gets the treatment and comes out smooth, before and after
idea: A playful Halloween idea for a real med spa client. The pumpkin stands in for the client, so the ad shows before and after without showing a patient.
why: A seasonal hook people want to share.
Before and after without patient photos.
Light and fun while still selling the treatment.
